name: As One Corp
summary: AS ONE Corporation, a Japanese company with a global presence, specializes in the distribution of a wide array of scientific instruments, research equipment, and essential products for nursing and healthcare. Its diverse catalog of scientific instruments includes devices for temperature and humidity control, alongside measuring and surveying tools. It also supplies versatile equipment for laboratory processes such as cooling, heating, mixing, absorption, pressurization, and material conveyance. For biotechnology, AS ONE provides microscopes, glass slides, and tissue culture products. Precision work and analytical technology are supported by magnifying glasses, filters, and dispensing apparatus. Essential research facility equipment encompasses experimental platforms, fume hoods, pharmaceutical storage units, general storage solutions, wagons, laboratory seating, and material handling gear. Additionally, the company offers fundamental lab consumables like various containers for samples, reagents, and materials; indispensable glassware and plasticware such as beakers and flasks; hoses, tubes, and connectors; along with practical items like tapes, labels, timers, packaging machinery, tools, and office supplies tailored for laboratory environments. The company also supplies industrial-grade equipment, including dehumidifying storage solutions, organizational and conveyance systems, and various sterilization, disinfecting, and cleaning products such as ultrasonic cleaners, detergents, and drying tools. Its offerings extend to personal protective equipment like safety glasses, masks, and gloves. Furthermore, AS ONE provides specialized items for clean rooms, including specific tools, containers, dust-proof apparel, anti-static products, and essential clean room mats. For the medical and nursing sectors, AS ONE provides hospital and nursing instruments, encompassing PPE like white gowns, masks, and gloves. It supplies rack systems designed for nursing stations, a diverse range of products, supplies, and equipment crucial for hospital nursing or general care, along with sterilizers and sterilization lockers. The company further offers mobility and patient comfort items such as care cars, beds, and a selection of bathing and sanitary products. Established in Osaka, Japan, in 1933, the company continues to maintain its headquarters there.
